Basis: The bootstrap composes the reviewed lifecycle, consent, privacy, accessibility, identity, rest, anti-discrimination, civic, ecological, and audit controls into a deterministic local runtime contract
Local-first evaluation, no background telemetry, no autonomous browsing, reduced external transfer, offline support, and minimized audit structures reduce compute and network demand

Fail-closed aggregation blocks unsafe transitions; no automatic external actions, hardware control, tracking, identity resolution, sensitive-data inference, or status-conditioned service access is present

Accessibility defaults, assistive-technology support, low-bandwidth and offline modes, non-digital pathways, accommodations, notices, correction, and appeal are initialized as mandatory runtime conditions

The composition preserves identity sovereignty, psych-continuity, neural privacy, revocable consent, Recognition at Rest, non-extractability, non-discrimination, essential-service independence, transparent governance, and ecological responsibility
